digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess runtime environment
propositions: write/apply and subprocess paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtimes, allowing unintended scope writes and credential leakage
Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that can write under unintended scope
child process environments inherit full parent state without adapter-specific isolation, causing unrelated siblings to access other adapters' secrets and Rebar to mutate global os.environ
every implicit DIG default in resolve_jira_settings, access_check probe, runtime constant, and project_ensures must be eliminated so no request uses DIG unless explicitly configured
read/check paths use operation bindings (S2) but write/apply paths and bridge orchestration remain on legacy config rebuild without scoped runtime isolation
